references.finding: Chrome extension service workers do not support dynamic import(). Static imports require module worker type; importScripts is also supported.
Background type module opts into shared ESM chunks. Omitting type bundles background separately as an IIFE.
Only module background joins the ESM group with HTML pages. Default background is individual.
Individual background uses Vite library mode IIFE; the actual green emitted bundle must prove no dynamic imports remain.

Vite catches baseModule rejection using handlePreloadError, which calls window.dispatchEvent before rethrowing original error. In a worker that ReferenceError masks the unsupported dynamic import rejection.

diagnosis.confirmed: The emitted module worker contains unsupported dynamic import expressions. modulePreload:false does not remove them. data_patterns.prepare awaits a dynamic CDP handler import before approval. Both worker bootstrap and sibling handlers can hit the same unsupported boundary.
